QUOTE: "`ClientPosts.createPost` passes `noRetry: true` (`app/client/rest/posts.ts:46`), and `tracking.ts:383-384` turns that into `retryPolicyConfiguration = {retryLimit: 0}`. So the request is not retried at the HTTP layer either."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the create-post request is sent once with no automatic retries (noRetry: true, retryLimit 0, "zero automatic retries"), and that retry is manual only.
